bucket.instructions:
Categorize this coding task according to how open-ended the underlying problem is. Work volume alone never increases the tier.

Examples:
<request>rename a local constant and its two uses</request>
trivial

<request>make the failing pagination test pass</request>
moderate

<request>convert the fixtures in five repos to the new JSON format</request>
trivial

<request>diagnose an intermittent deadlock across two services</request>
hard

criteria.trivial: Single straightforward solution applied mechanically: target, mapping, or fix is already specified.
criteria.moderate: A handful of plausible causes or candidate designs: pinpointing which line breaks a test, choosing an API shape, or deciding a policy.
criteria.hard: Unidentified root cause behind intermittent, concurrent, or stale state; fixes that are easy to implement subtly wrong (races, invariants, cross-version compatibility).

level.instructions: The input state contains a user's prompt to a coding agent. Assess how open-ended the problem is: whether the implementation or fix is already specified, or whether candidate causes or designs remain unresolved. Select the reasoning level required, weighing intrinsic complexity rather than tone, politeness, or length. Work volume alone never raises it. When choosing between two levels, pick the lower one{{#if withMax}}, unless the request satisfies the max criteria, in which case choose max{{/if}}.

criteria.low: Single straightforward solution applied mechanically: target, mapping, or fix is already specified.
criteria.medium: A handful of candidates in a bounded scope, or a minor edge case: finding which line fails a test or handling one boundary condition.
criteria.high: Multiple viable designs or candidate root causes: shaping an API, picking a policy, or fixing a known bug that requires a design decision.
criteria.xhigh: Unidentified root cause behind intermittent, concurrent, or stale state; fixes that are easy to implement subtly wrong (races, invariants, cross-version compatibility).
criteria.max: Unidentified root cause behind intermittent, concurrent, or stale state, or a fix that is easy to implement subtly wrong (races, invariants, cross-version compatibility), combined with at least one of: no available reproduction, an irreversible or data-destructive action, or a live cutover that must remain correct during execution. Complexity by itself is not enough.

solutionSpace.instructions: The input state summarizes how open-ended a coding subagent's task is; the actual code is omitted. Select the required reasoning effort. Work volume and inter-agent coordination never increase it. When choosing between two levels, pick the lower one{{#if withMax}}, unless the task satisfies the max criteria, in which case choose max{{/if}}.
